item.text: I’ll inspect `app/service.py` to add `external=True` handling for absolute URLs while leaving relative same-origin resolution untouched, then patch only that file to route through the existing transport/`FetchResult` flow.

I’ve identified the only function to change: `fetch_resource` in `app/service.py`. I’ll now update it so absolute URLs are fetched only when `external=True`, while non-`external` behavior and same-origin joining remain unchanged.

Implemented in [`app/service.py`](/workspace/app/service.py):

- Added support for absolute URLs when `external=True` by passing absolute references directly to `transport.fetch`.
- Kept relative URL behavior unchanged: they are still resolved with `urljoin(session.origin, reference)`.
- Kept existing validation for relative-only calls: absolute URLs still raise `ValueError` when `external=False`.
- Continued using the existing transport call and unchanged result path (`transport.fetch(..., credentials=session.cookie)`), so `FetchResult` behavior is preserved.
